name: Wallpaper Engine
description: Browse the local Wallpaper Engine library and switch OpenClaw Control UI image, GIF and video backgrounds.

libraryRoot.description: Wallpaper Engine workshop content directory. Defaults to D:\steam\steamapps\workshop\content\431960

ffmpegPath.description: Path to ffmpeg.exe used to convert GIF/video previews into still images.

cacheDir.description: Where converted still frames are cached.

controlUiRoot.description: Absolute path to the Control UI directory served by this gateway.
